purpose: Company-page opener: a mono eyebrow (the h1), a large all-caps statement and a full-width decorative banner (a pattern strip or a wide pattern image) that gives the page a brand-colour anchor before the story content.

variants.name: teal-pattern-strip
variants.description: About: a teal-6 backdrop fills the whole header (full bleed below xl, container width at xl) behind the eyebrow, a two-line statement and a right-aligned tiled pattern strip 76px tall (152px from md). The statement is a paragraph, not a heading.

variants.name: full-width-image
variants.description: Careers: eyebrow and h2 statement on a plain background, then a 1400 by 752 pattern image that overlaps the next section via negative bottom margins.

statement.note: Large all-caps heading-font statement. Observed 9 words (About, two lines) and 5 words (Careers).

banner.note: About: tiled PNG used as a CSS background image. Careers: 1400 by 752 jpg with empty alt.

behaviour.note:
Semantic difference between variants: About's statement is a

, Careers' is an

. Both keep the eyebrow as the h1.
Both are page-local components (About defines its own Hero function), not shared files.

changes.change: About: top padding 40 / 48 (md) / 56 (xl); Careers: vertical padding 40 / 48 / 56 the same way
About pattern strip height doubles from 76px to 152px
About teal backdrop and pattern strip bleed to the viewport edge (negative side margins); at xl they align to the container
Careers image aspect 1400/752; it overlaps the next section by 40 / 48 (md) / 56 (lg) / 64 (xl) px with top margin 4 / 8 (sm) / 12 (lg) / 16 (xl)
